scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix e2e ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:auth
scripts.lint: eslint backend/src backend/scripts e2e scripts --max-warnings 0 && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check:version && npm run check:env
